scope: Web listener participant-card stream preview; no Flutter change or native/media-quality claim

environment.stack: isolated Go API, PostgreSQL and LiveKit; synthetic screen source

checks.name: web_unit_suite
checks.observation: 498 files and 1,688 tests passed, including the fetch receiver regression.

checks.name: web_typecheck_and_production_build
checks.observation: vue-tsc and Vite production build passed. Existing LiveKit import and large-chunk warnings remain.

checks.name: screen_share_browser_suite
checks.observation: 40 browser cases passed, including equal-sized cards at desktop and 200% mobile text, avatar loading, left-aligned names, mute icon sizing, inline preview selection and no horizontal page overflow.

checks.name: critical_acceptance_driver
checks.observation: All 29 cases pass. Added coverage for selecting an inline participant-card preview before falling back to the stream panel; this fixes the CI lifecycle test harness after the UI moved previews into cards.

checks.name: ci_gate_routing
checks.observation: The three Web-specific critical screen-share driver paths route to contracts and Web rather than the uncertain all-platform fallback. Actual lifecycle selection remains covered by the separate risk plan.

checks.name: authenticated_real_stack
checks.command: ./tools/qa/local_features/check.sh --feature screen --feature voice --feature shell --feature auth --feature connection_status --platform web --base origin/master --real-stack
checks.observation: All 24 reported stages passed, including API/SFU lifecycle and decoded inline thumbnail at 1440px and 393px. The full report remains REVIEW_REQUIRED because only the four feature-relevant screenshots listed below received manual visual review.

checks.name: scoped_visual_review
checks.observation: All four participant-card captures were inspected at original resolution. Layout and responsive observations are recorded in the local visual-review note.

artifacts.visual_observation: Stream image occupies the card's 16:9 header; the voice-only card has the same dimensions and a calm status placeholder. Names align to the left edge of the avatar/text row; avatars load at 40px and the mute icon box matches the status font size.
At 200% root text, cards stack without horizontal page overflow and retain equal height. Long labels wrap within the participant information area.
An API/SFU-published screen preview appears inside the sharing participant's card beside an equal-sized voice-only card. Participant name and microphone state remain in the card footer.
Mobile real-stack capture keeps the stream preview and voice-only placeholder in matching cards, with the room controls remaining visible below.

limitations: Real-stack uses synthetic screen pixels; physical browser capture and media quality are NOT_RUN.
The full local-feature report remains REVIEW_REQUIRED for screenshots outside this feature-specific visual review.
Flutter is the supplied visual reference; Flutter source and runtime were not changed or retested.
